name: Sluiceway
subtitle: Lift every boat to its pier
shortDescription: Open and close canal gates so the water rises and falls, and lift every little boat to its pier through 153 canals in nine harbours.
longDescription:
The river is high, the sea is low, and a little red boat needs to reach its pier. You hold the sluice gates. Open one and water rushes through; shut it and the level holds. Make the water rise and fall, and lift every boat to its dock.

Sluiceway is a calm canal-lock puzzle in real 3D. Basins sit side by side, each one a step lower than the last. Tap a gate wheel to open or close it. Water in basins joined by open gates settles to one level, exactly as in a real canal lock, and a boat can only sail through when it floats on both sides. Plan your gates, then watch the water pour. Undo and restart are free, so you can think out loud.

### Nine Harbours, A New Twist In Each
- Millpond: plain sluices and a river inlet, to learn how water finds its level.
- Estuary Docks: a sea gate that always holds the sea at its own height.
- Check-Valve Canal: one-way doors that let water through in only one direction.
- Pump House: pumps that lift water uphill into a higher basin.
- Leaky Weirs: closed doors that slowly seep.
- Tidal Reach: a tide that rises and falls with every move you make.
- Freight Yard: heavy freighters that need deep water, beside nimble light boats.
- Twin-Lock Gates: chained gate pairs, where opening one shuts its twin.
- Grand Harbour: springs, plus everything you have learned so far.
Each wheel carries its own icon and colour, so you can always see what a gate does.

### 153 Canals, Every One Solvable
Seventeen canals in each harbour; the last is a boss with the most boats and the trickiest plumbing. Every canal is checked by a solver, so there is always an answer, and the three-star target is the true shortest number of moves. No timers, no lives, nothing is ever unwinnable.

### A Harbour That Grows With You
Earn coins by playing and spend them in the Boatyard on 36 boats in different hull styles and colours, each with a fixed visible price (no random loot, no boxes). Cosmetic upgrades such as a bell, a lighthouse, bunting and flower boxes decorate your harbour on the title screen.

### Every Day, And Endlessly
A fresh Daily Canal, the same for everyone, with a streak. Endless Harbour Master hands you a shift of canal after canal that gets harder every three canals; finish a canal over its move budget and you earn a strike, three strikes end the shift. A short Watch and Learn lesson explains the basics. Plays offline, no account.
whatsNew: Version 1.0 launch: 153 canals in nine harbours, 36 boats to collect, a Daily Canal and the endless Harbour Master shift.
